in_sanskrit.name: Soleman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Soleman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Soleman is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'Sun'. In Hinduism, Surya is the deity of the Sun and is considered the source of all energy and life. The name Soleman signifies power, leadership, wisdom, and a connection to the divine.
